priority.override_reason: Ranks one through twelve are closed by exact-current retained or rejected frame, call, object, property, RegExp, string, constructor, and typed-loop admission evidence. Rank-thirteen bitops-bits-in-byte exposes a different representation boundary inside an already-retained executor: 1,297 of 3,658 current samples land directly in typed-loop run, and its 519,680,000 diagnosed typed operations use no boxed operations while every scalar register is a 16-byte enum. Rank-twenty-one iterative SHA-256 independently places 829 of 2,794 samples in the same executor and runs 291,670,744 typed operations, 99.98 percent scalar. Packing the private scalar register representation is distinct from the rejected register-count compaction and admission extensions because it changes the per-operation width and tag test for every already-admitted region without changing which bytecode is admitted.

mechanism.summary: Replace the private 16-byte typed-loop scalar enum with a safe eight-byte packed scalar word that carries ECMAScript Numbers, Booleans, and undefined. Reserve explicit quiet-NaN payloads for non-number tags, canonicalize numeric NaNs away from those tags, and keep the existing typed-loop operations, deoptimization sites, boxed side table, and admission policy unchanged.
mechanism.generality: Every existing TypedLoopProgram uses the same packed scalar word solely because the program already classified a register as scalar. The representation never inspects workload names, source paths, function names, input sizes, iteration counts, checksums, or results. It is private to the retained typed-loop tier; public Value, bytecode IR, parser, AST, object ownership, and other execution tiers remain unchanged. The implementation is safe Rust and does not use pointer tagging or unsafe code.
semantic_risks: numeric NaN payloads must never alias the reserved Boolean or undefined tags, while every NaN must retain ECMAScript Number behavior
positive zero, negative zero, infinities, ordinary finite numbers, Boolean truthiness, and undefined-to-numeric conversion must round-trip exactly through Value and deoptimization

numeric arithmetic, bitwise conversion, comparisons, unary operations, updates, dense reads and writes, helper results, sloppy-global publication, and boxed materialization must decode the same logical type as the current enum
a guard failure or residency exit must rebuild the generic operand stack and frame slots with the same Values and resume at the same bytecode site
the packed scalar must remain exactly eight bytes with no unsafe code, while TypedOp layout, program admission, operation counts, and boxed-register behavior remain unchanged
